story.heading: Our story
story.p1: The Heart House and Vascular Care started in 1979 as a small clinical-cardiology group in southern New Jersey. Today the practice covers every cardiology subspecialty across 34 physicians, six offices, and nine hospital affiliations.
story.p2: Physician-owned and physician-led. Affiliated with CVA USA, a national network of independent cardiovascular practices.

nondiscrimination.title: Notice of Nondiscrimination
nondiscrimination.intro: The Heart House and Vascular Care complies with applicable federal civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, disability, or sex. We do not exclude people or treat them differently because of race, color, national origin, age, disability, or sex.
nondiscrimination.aids: Aids and services to people with disabilities to communicate effectively with us, including qualified sign language interpreters and written information in other formats such as large print, audio, or accessible electronic formats.
nondiscrimination.languageServices: Language services to people whose primary language is not English, including qualified interpreters and information written in other languages.
nondiscrimination.requestServices: If you need these services, contact our office at {phone} (TTY: {tty}).
nondiscrimination.grievanceBody: If you believe that The Heart House and Vascular Care has failed to provide these services or discriminated in another way on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, disability, or sex, you can file a grievance with our office. Call {phone} (TTY: {tty}) and ask for the practice administrator. You can file in person, by mail, by fax, or by phone, and we can help you complete the grievance.
nondiscrimination.ocrHeading: File a complaint with the U.S. government
nondiscrimination.ocrBody: You can also file a civil rights complaint with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office for Civil Rights, electronically through the Office for Civil Rights Complaint Portal, or by mail or phone. Complaint forms are available online.
nondiscrimination.ocrPortal: Office for Civil Rights Complaint Portal
nondiscrimination.taglinesIntro: Free language assistance services, including qualified interpreters, are available to you at no cost. Call {phone} (TTY: {tty}) and tell us what language you speak.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.commitment: The Heart House and Vascular Care is committed to making this app usable by everyone, including people who use screen readers, keyboard navigation, magnification, or other assistive technology.
accessibility.standardBody: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. This app is built mobile-first with large tap targets, visible keyboard focus, a skip-to-content link, text alternatives for images, and color contrast checked against the AA threshold.
accessibility.limitationsBody: Some content is provided by third parties and is outside our direct control, including the embedded Google map, Google reviews, and the patient portal, scheduling, and bill-pay sites we link to. If you have trouble with any of these, call us and a staff member will help you complete the task by phone.
accessibility.feedbackBody: If you run into an accessibility barrier in this app, we want to hear about it. Call {phone} (TTY: {tty}) and ask for the practice administrator. Please tell us the page you were on and what happened, and we will respond and work to fix it.
accessibility.alternativeBody: Anything you can do in this app you can also do by phone. Call {phone} during office hours and our staff will schedule appointments, give directions, answer test-prep questions, or read information to you.
